name: Hugging Face Inference Providers

freeTier.note: Free accounts receive a small monthly inference credit that renews each month; paid accounts get more. The allowance is denominated in credit, not tokens, and its size is not exposed by this API — so remaining budget is UNKNOWN until the operator records it.

notes: Meta-router over multiple upstream inference providers. Token-level routing means the real serving provider can vary per request, so latency and reliability statistics stay attached to the HF model id.
